messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 4076543210 - SLO breach: streaming-tail p99 > 5s in eu-west2 for 10m :rotating_light: - alert details https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/4076543210

alex: seeing a lot of p99 spikes and intermittent streaming stalls, anyone on-call?

sre-jordan: i'm on it, paging @oncall-uk. pulling up dashboards now.

oncall-uk: taking pager. confirmed on dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/streaming-latency?region=eu-west2 - p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~6.8s over last 20m.

netops-lee: infra telemetry shows DNS lookup timeouts from edge nodes to our resolvers in eu-west2 and a big jump in tcp_syn retransmits at nat-eu-west2.

maria: CS: customers reporting degraded playback and reconnect loops, elevated error-rate on ingest endpoints ~2%.

incident-bot: Runbook suggestion: egress mitigations -> 1) traffic-shift to alternate region 2) reduce DNS TTL 3) increase NAT ephemeral port pool. Use /runbook to execute safe steps.

sre-jordan: quick probe: traceroute streaming-gw-eu-a -> egress-nat shows multiple hops with packet loss ~1-3% and increased latency. attaching logs snippet.

sre-jordan: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T14:20:12Z] streaming-gw-eu-a tail_latency_ms=7200 conn_retries=3 dns_lookup_ms=240
[2026-03-15T14:20:15Z] nat-eu-west2 tcp_syn_retrans=18 ephemeral_ports_exhausted=0.23
```

netops-lee: ephemeral_ports_exhausted=0.23 means ~23% of ephemeral pool exhausted on some hosts, which can drive NAT port contention and handshake failures.

alex: can we temporarily steer traffic from eu-west2 -> eu-west3? what's safe increment?

oncall-uk: i'll do incremental 25% steps. executing step1 now.

oncall-uk: /infra traffic-shift --from eu-west2 --to eu-west3 --percent 25 --reason "mitigate nat/tls handshake spikes"

incident-bot: Action scheduled: traffic-shift job id 9876 started.

netops-lee: also dropping DNS TTL for streaming domain to 30s to force clients to re-resolve to new egress path.

maria: CS posting initial status: "Investigating degraded streaming for EU customers, mitigation in progress. ETA 15-30m." filing to status.redwood.ai

customer-success-sam: notifying enterprise contacts, sharing temporary workaround (refresh stream).

sre-jordan: after 25% shift p99 dropped to ~4.1s, p95 ~1.0s. improvement but still above SLO.

oncall-uk: proceeding to additional shift to 60% total.

oncall-uk: /infra traffic-shift --from eu-west2 --to eu-west3 --percent 35 --job 9876

incident-bot: job 9876 update: total shifted 60%.

netops-lee: monitoring NAT metrics: tcp_syn_retrans decreased ~40%, ephemeral usage down to ~12% since shift.

sre-jordan: running conntrack cleanup on a few hosts to clear stale entries: 
```
sudo conntrack -L | grep nat-eu-west2
sudo conntrack -D --orig-src 10.32.0.0/16
```

alex: any impact observed in eu-west3 after shift?

netops-lee: eu-west3 healthy; small p95 increase but within SLO, capacity headroom present.

incident-bot: Alert persists: streaming-tail p99 now ~2.2s (target <1s) - continued monitoring.

maria: CS reports fewer customer complaints after shift, still monitoring premium accounts.

sre-jordan: next action: increase NAT ephemeral port range on eu-west2 nodes (32768->65535) to reduce chance of port exhaustion while shift continues.

oncall-uk: scheduling batched config rollout to avoid conntrack storms.

oncall-uk: /ops apply-config nat-ephemeral-range --region eu-west2 --new-range 32768-65535 --batch 10

incident-bot: config apply job 9921 started.

netops-lee: also restarted DNS forwarding process on two overloaded forwarders in eu-west2. should reduce lookup latency.

sre-jordan: post-change metrics: p99 ~1.1s, p95 ~0.85s; streaming stalls for shifted traffic near zero.

alex: looks like mitigations working. how long before we consider closing the pager?

maria: CS wants 60m of stable metrics before removing status page; enterprise outreach will stay until then.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m. please post a handoff summary.

sre-jordan: handoff summary:
- probable root cause: intermittent packet loss and TLS handshake retransmits on eu-west2 egress path; amplification due to NAT ephemeral contention and overloaded DNS forwarders.
- mitigation steps executed: incremental traffic-shift to eu-west3 (60%), lowered DNS TTL, restarted forwarders, increased nat ephemeral port range on eu-west2, conntrack cleanup.
- immediate impact: p99 reduced from ~7s to ~1.1s, customer reports down significantly.
- follow-ups: monitor for 1h, revert traffic gradually once stable, schedule postmortem if recurrence within 48h, investigate upstream provider path with NOC.

customer-success-sam: CS updated with summary, sent notes to affected enterprise customers.

oncall-uk: handing off to @sre-maya for the daytime shift in ~45m.

sre-maya: ack taking over, will keep watch and coordinate PM if we see reoccurrence.

incident-bot: Incident record created: https://incidents.redwood.ai/incidents/4076543210 - severity P2.

alex: thanks all for the quick triage :thumbsup: we'll keep monitoring and follow up with a full write-up.
